manifesto: We are filmmakers first, engineers second.
We film what has soul. We generate the impossible.
AI doesn't sign our work — it executes under our direction.

method.label: The method
method.title: We film · We generate · We integrate

steps.title: We film
steps.text: What has soul: the gaze, the skin, the product.

steps.title: We generate
steps.text: What would be impossible or out of reach.

steps.title: We integrate
steps.text: Seamlessly. And we show the seams anyway.

ethics.label: Ethics
ethics.title: Transparency is part of the craft
ethics.lead: We comply with the EU AI Act. Everything generated is traceable. No real person appears in our work without explicit consent. Transparency isn't a disclaimer — it's part of the craft.
points: EU AI Act: compliance on every delivery.
Traceability: a record of what was generated and with which tool.
Real people appear only with explicit, written consent.

studio.label: Studio
studio.title: Alumar: to give light
studio.lead: Alumar is a Galician verb. Not making light: deciding where it falls.
body: Aluma is a film studio based in Galicia, Spain. We produce cinema-grade work by combining live action and AI generation.
The machine executes, composes and renders. Only a human feels, directs and carries the artistic risk.
We film what has soul and generate what would be out of reach. Every piece ships with its breakdown: what was filmed, what was generated, how it was integrated.
